regression_fix.additional_test: Same PID with exactly matching identity is accepted; inconsistent creation time is rejected
regression_fix.source_freeze: Final sources captured after the fix and before the full final regression; source hashes verified by the audit

scope: Original native ready frame checked before exclusive journal creation
Exact request bytes and metadata fsynced before the execute callback
Exact reply bytes and metadata fsynced before pipe send
Actual isolated OpenCode file tool and fixed Node checks correlated to original SDK session/message/call IDs
Real pending SDK callback sees the original durable request before any response
Original operation collector returns request/reply bytes and preserves unproven correlation for truncated SDK output
Actual cancellation, lifetime, task budget and startup recovery affected regressions

limitations: Affected regression only; neither full repository testing nor complete S1 acceptance
Partial records, missing originals and invalid SDK output remain unknown or refused; original bytes are retained
Journal capacity limits are logical bounds, not physical disk quota enforcement
Concurrent collection may be partial and does not claim one final atomic snapshot
SDK/IPC byte correspondence does not independently reverify Native effects or produce domain RunObservation
Full production model/tool/account custody, formal Runtime admission and result verifier remain pending
Exact Zhipu model, plan, service-side bounds and cash/credit cap remain unconfirmed; no paid requests authorized
Billing, physical quotas, historical capacity and complete cross-logon/boot recovery remain pending
Real skills and clarification before Plan/Task, independent review/fresh verification remain pending
Workbench formal Agent and real Change to ReadyForDelivery S1 acceptance remain pending
Old-machine historical Unknown resources and DPAPI CurrentUser credentials are not portable through Git
